description:
Location: Remote (US or Canada).

Employment Type: Full-time

About the role

We're hiring a Product Marketing Manager to turn what we build into a clear story for TikTok Shop brands and agencies. Reacher is an AI-powered TikTok Shop affiliate platform used by thousands of brands. We build Pro software for creator discovery, outreach, and affiliate CRM; Reacher Plus, our AI-native managed agency; and the Creator Network app. You'll own positioning, launches, and the sales and marketing materials that help people understand why Reacher is the right tool. This is a hands-on role at a small company, so you will write the copy, run the launches, and stay close to customers and product.

What you'll do

  • Write positioning and messaging for Pro, Reacher Plus, and the Creator app

  • Run product launches: the story, the materials, and the follow-through with sales and marketing

  • Turn features like creator outreach, affiliate CRM, and GMV tools into clear stories brands actually care about

  • Build sales decks, one-pagers, and talk tracks, and keep them current as the product changes

  • Talk to customers and lost deals so messaging stays honest about what works and what doesn't

  • Work closely with product, sales, and marketing so launches land cleanly

What you bring

  • Experience as a product marketer at a startup or growth-stage company, ideally in B2B software

  • You've taken a product or feature from a messy internal description to a launch that sales and customers could use

  • You write clearly and can explain a product without jargon

  • Comfort talking to customers and turning what you hear into sharper messaging

  • Comfort working fast in a startup and doing the work yourself

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, social commerce, or creator marketing

  • Experience marketing to ecommerce brands or agencies

  • You've built sales enablement from scratch on a small team
